# Security

Security fixes target the latest published preview. Older previews are retained for rollback and may not receive fixes.

Use GitHub's private [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/gagexhill/grid-wallpaper/security/advisories/new) form in the Security tab. Do not post vulnerabilities, credentials, personal information or private logs in public issues or pull requests.

If the private reporting form is unavailable, open an issue requesting a private reporting channel without including vulnerability details.

Include the affected release, Windows and Lively versions, a minimal reproduction and the expected security impact in the private report. Remove personal paths, account information and session files from attachments. The installed `windows-host.json` and `windows-telemetry.js` files must never be shared.
